title: Multi-dimensional Racism Classification during COVID-19: Stigmatization, Offensiveness, Blame, and Exclusion
reasoning: The paper utilizes the BERT model to detect and classify human-generated racist discourse into four categories: stigmatization, offensiveness, blame, and exclusion. While the subject of racism is an ethical and social concern, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as specified in the criteria, but rather applies computational methods to analyze social media behavior.
